question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH last_races AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) AS last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
driver_leaders AS (
    SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points, ds.position
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
constructor_leaders AS (
    SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points, cs.position
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT 
    dl.year,
    'Driver' AS category,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    dl.points AS points
FROM driver_leaders dl
JOIN drivers d ON dl.driver_id = d.driver_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    cl.year,
    'Constructor' AS category,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    cl.points AS points
FROM constructor_leaders cl
JOIN constructors c ON cl.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY year, category
